description: Defines structures, inline functions, and external function declarations for managing netlink cacheable objects, including reference counting, marking, and attribute handling.

methods.name: nl_object_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a new nl_object with specified operations.

methods.name: nl_object_clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of the given nl_object.

methods.name: nl_object_shared
methods.description: Checks if the object is used by multiple users based on reference count.

methods.name: nl_object_get
methods.description: Increments the reference count of the object.

methods.name: nl_object_put
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and frees the object if count reaches zero.

methods.name: nl_object_mark
methods.description: Marks the object with a flag.

methods.name: nl_object_unmark
methods.description: Removes the mark flag from the object.

methods.name: nl_object_is_marked
methods.description: Checks if the object is marked.

methods.name: nl_object_get_refcnt
methods.description: Returns the reference count of the object.

methods.name: nl_object_get_cache
methods.description: Returns the cache associated with the object.

methods.name: nl_object_priv
methods.description: Returns the private data pointer of the object.
